_meta.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 - Rule 6, read with the Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (Sec 18)
_meta.disclaimer: This ruleset is a software encoding of publicly available summaries of Rule 6 for the purpose of automated screening. It is NOT a substitute for legal advice and MUST be reviewed and signed off by a Legal Metrology / legal compliance officer before use in any enforcement decision. Verify clause numbers against the current consolidated Rules (as amended) on consumeraffairs.gov.in before production use.

declarations.title: Name and address of manufacturer/packer/importer
declarations.notes: Where the manufacturer is not the packer, both must appear. For imported goods, importer's name and address is also mandatory. 'Marketed by' with full brand-owner address is acceptable per departmental FAQs.

declarations.title: Country of origin
declarations.notes: Mandatory only where the product is imported. Compliance engine flags this only when 'imported' flag is set for the product/listing.

declarations.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
declarations.notes: For multi-product packages, name and quantity of each product must be declared.

declarations.title: Net quantity in standard units (weight/volume/number)
declarations.notes: Must be expressed in standard SI/legal units. Weight of packaging material must be excluded (Rule 11). Number of pieces required when sold by count.

declarations.title: Month and year of manufacture / packing / import
declarations.notes: May be expressed in words or numerals or both. Applying month/date via a separate sticker after original printing is prohibited by Rule 6(2), except for permitted MRP reductions.

declarations.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes
declarations.notes: Must state 'inclusive of all taxes' or equivalent. Either ₹ symbol or 'Rs.' abbreviation is acceptable per Legal Metrology FAQs (Sept/Nov 2025).

declarations.title: Unit sale price (price per standard unit)
declarations.notes: Not required where MRP equals unit sale price, and not required to be displayed on e-commerce websites (only required on the physical package itself).

declarations.title: Consumer care / contact details (name, address, telephone/email)
declarations.notes: Telephone number/email address, if available, must be declared along with name/address of contact person or office.

declarations.title: Mandatory declarations on e-commerce listing (excl. month/year of mfg)
declarations.notes: E-commerce entities must ensure all Rule 6(1) declarations appear on the digital listing, except month/year of manufacture/packing which is not required online.

prohibited_practices.title: Individual stickers used to alter/declare date of manufacture or MRP
prohibited_practices.notes: Prohibited except for legitimate reduced-MRP stickers that do not cover the original printed MRP declaration.

prohibited_practices.title: More than one MRP declared without clear superseding indication
Misleading quantity/price claims (e.g. '1kg' printed larger than actual net content, or exaggerated free-quantity claims)
